#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class Main {
public:
    void runProgram() {
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;
        vector<int> v(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int idx;

        }

        int power = n / 2;

            }

        }
        long long answer = 0;
        for (int value : result) {
            answer = (answer + (long long)value * value) % 998244353;
        }
        cout << answer << endl;

    vector<int> multiplyPolynomials(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int requiredLength = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int n = 1;
        while (n < requiredLength) n <<= 1;

        vector<double> ar(n, 0.0), ai(n, 0.0);
        vector<double> br(n, 0.0), bi(n, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
            long long x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            ar[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            ai[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
            long long x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            br[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            bi[i] = x >> 15;
        }

        performFFT(ar, ai, false);
        performFFT(br, bi, false);

        vector<double> resRe1(n, 0.0), resIm1(n, 0.0);
        vector<double> resRe2(n, 0.0), resIm2(n, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
            double a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5;
            double a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5;
            double a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5;
            double a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5;

            double b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5;
            double b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5;
            double b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5;
            double b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5;

            resRe1[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            resIm1[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
            resRe2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
            resIm2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
        }

        performFFT(resRe1, resIm1, true);
        performFFT(resRe2, resIm2, true);

        vector<int> output(requiredLength);
        for (int i = 0; i < requiredLength; i++) {
            long long aa = llround(resRe1[i]);
            long long bb = llround(resRe2[i]);
            long long cc = llround(resIm1[i]);
            output[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return output;
    }

    void performFFT(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
        int n = re.size();
        int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_clz(i) - shift;
            j = (n - 1) ^ j;
            if (i < j) {
                double temp = re[i];
                re[i] = re[j];
                re[j] = temp;
                temp = im[i];
                im[i] = im[j];
                im[j] = temp;
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    double angle = 2 * M_PI * j / len;
                    double wRe = cos(angle);
                    double wIm = inverse ? -sin(angle) : sin(angle);

                    double uRe = re[i + j];
                    double uIm = im[i + j];
                    double vRe = re[i + j + half] * wRe - im[i + j + half] * wIm;
                    double vIm = re[i + j + half] * wIm + im[i + j + half] * wRe;

                    re[i + j] = uRe + vRe;
                    im[i + j] = uIm + vIm;
                    re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe;
                    im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm;
                }
            }
        }

        if (inverse) {
            double invN = 1.0 / n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] *= invN;
                im[i] *= invN;
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
